newsitem.title: USA: N.J. Gov sees no state takeover of Camden -- paper.
newsitem.headline: N.J. Gov sees no state takeover of Camden -- paper.

text.p: New Jersey Gov. Christine Whitman said increased state intervention in Camden's finances would not lead to a takeover of the city, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Wednesday.

The state's Department of Community Affairs is examining whether a special board could be established to work with the mayor and city council on policy decisions. A decision on such a board could be announced as early as next month.
But Whitman said the review is not a step toward a full-scale state takeover of the cash-strapped city, according to the newspaper.
Camden has yet to submit a balanced budget for fiscal 1997, which ends on June 30. The city is trying to close a $796,000 deficit in the $100 million spending plan.
